authority: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India & Department of Rural Development
benefit: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 (Plains) / ₹1,30,000 (Hilly/NE/IAP) for pucca house construction + 90 days MGNREGA wages + ₹12,000 for toilet

criteria.label: Deprivation & houseless / kutcha house dwelling status
criteria.plain_description: Beneficiary must be living in a kutcha house (kutcha wall and kutcha roof) or be houseless according to SECC 2011 list.
criteria.source_clause: PMAY-G Framework for Implementation Section 2.1 (Identification of Beneficiary)
criteria.remediation: Upload Ration Card (BPL/PHH) or Gram Panchayat SECC inclusion certification.

criteria.label: Annual household income ceiling for rural housing assistance
criteria.plain_description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹1,80,000 from all sources.
criteria.remediation: Provide an Income Certificate verifying household income under ₹1.8 Lakh/year.

criteria.label: Land ownership / house site possession
criteria.plain_description: Beneficiary must own land or have unencumbered allotment of land for house construction.
criteria.source_clause: PMAY-G Operational Guidelines Clause 4.2 (Landless & Homestead Assistance)
criteria.remediation: Upload Patta, Land Record, or Gram Panchayat House Site Certificate.

criteria.label: Aadhaar authentication and seeded DBT bank account
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar seeded bank account is mandatory for 3 staggered installment disbursements.
criteria.source_clause: PMAY-G Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Protocol Section 5

application.office_name: Gram Panchayat Office or Block Development Office (BDO)
documents_to_carry: Bank Account Passbook showing Aadhaar NPCI seeding
BPL Ration Card / Job Card under MGNREGA
process_steps: Registration done by Gram Rozgar Sahayak (GRS) on AwaasApp with geo-tagged photo of existing kutcha house
Gram Sabha approves priority list of beneficiaries
Sanction order issued by Block Development Officer
First installment of ₹40,000 credited to bank account for foundation level work
